items.title: Sonesta Cuts Jobs as a $2 Billion Bid Puts Many of Its Best Hotels in Play
items.summary: Service Properties Trust hired Sonesta to operate 68 of the hotels it owns. But an unsolicited offer for those hotels has created uncertainty. Meanwhile, Sonesta has cut corporate staff.

items.title: What Boston and Iceland Learned From a Sold-Out Summer of Live Tourism

items.title: The Hotel Industry Has A Water Problem
items.summary: Summer heat and drought brought hospitality’s use of water into sharp focus. The industry is betting on simple fixes like aerated showerheads and less laundry — the question is whether more structural but costly measures can scale.

items.title: AI Will Know Your Travelers. And the World’s Travelers. Will You?

items.title: The Sustainable Traveler Is More Mainstream Than the Industry Thinks
items.summary: There’s a widespread misconception that travelers looking for sustainable options are rare, earnest eco-seekers. In fact, they’re part of the mainstream, and often pragmatic in their choices.
